svg.title: GitHub contribution city for @sample-developer: 4243 contributions
svg.desc: Oldest weeks are on the left. Building height uses logarithmic weekly activity. Windows repeat each week's returned days, colored by contribution level. The antenna marks the most recent highest active week. The header total covers the full calendar returned by GitHub.
